decision: Confirmed execution registration requires an existing open workstream turn and a current workflow attempt when supplied. Activity uses bounded retained events and storage, recognizes duplicate/out-of-order/missing signals conservatively, and stays separate from source evidence. Recovery projection preserves stop, expiry, permission and retry blockers; unsupported host liveness, resume and cancellation remain unavailable, with remaining-work guidance instead of dispatch. Current source already implements the accepted scope; the missing current implementation report is recorded here.
rationale: Agent-reported progress; evidence is evaluated separately.
